Builder.Title: New Poll

ProposalRuleDescription.simple-majority: Approve beats Disapprove among decisive votes. Abstentions and absences are excluded from the count.
ProposalRuleDescription.absolute-majority: Approve must exceed half of all eligible participants. Abstentions and absences count against approval.
ProposalRuleDescription.majority-of-participants: Approve must exceed half of everyone who submitted a ballot. Abstentions count against approval; absences are excluded.
ProposalRuleDescription.unanimity-of-voters: Passes only if nobody disapproved and at least one participant approved. Abstentions and absences are excluded.
ProposalRuleDescription.unanimity-of-all-members: Passes only if every single eligible participant approved — no exceptions, no abstentions.
ProposalRuleDescription.supermajority: Approve must reach a chosen percentage of a chosen basis (Valid Votes, Submitted Ballots, or All Eligible).

Builder.SecretVoteHint: Hides ballot choices from the results screen, chat, and Journal exports. Not confidential against a player using their browser's developer console — see the module README.
Builder.LiveResultsHint: Show running aggregate counts while voting is active. Provisional until the poll closes.
Builder.WeightedVoteHint: Give each participant a configurable positive-integer vote weight instead of one vote each.
Builder.TimedVoteHint: Automatically close the poll at a fixed deadline instead of only by manual GM close.
Builder.QuorumHint: Require a minimum turnout percentage before the poll can produce an outcome.
Builder.AnotherPollActive: Another poll is already active. Only one poll may be active at a time.
Builder.DuplicateActorWarning: Two or more selected tokens are linked to the same Actor. Each will vote independently.
Builder.NoSceneTokens: The current Scene has no tokens.
